```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Run security scan
      run: |
        go get -u github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint
        golangci-lint run --timeout 5m
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/security-scan.yml` sets up a job named `security-scan` that runs on every push or pull request to the `main` branch. The job checks out the repository, sets up Go, and then runs `golangci-lint` to perform a security scan on the Go codebase. This helps ensure that any potential security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed before merging changes into the main branch.
